title: GALVANY — heat pumps sold, installed and then run against dynamic power prices, as one package
money_note: EUR 10M seed announced 2026-06-08 (lead investor SET Ventures' own release, the url), co-led by AENU; stated in EUR, no FX needed.
summary: Berlin-based GALVANY sells, installs (through a contractor and sales-partner network) and then operates heat-pump systems for existing homes, pairing a Panasonic-built heat pump with a battery and an energy-management system that shifts load against dynamic electricity tariffs. It raised a EUR 10M seed round in June 2026 after reporting EUR 20.1M revenue for 2025 and a positive EBIT.
notes: TRANSFER LOGIC: the buyer is a homeowner (and next, a multifamily owner) replacing a fossil boiler, who today has to assemble a heat pump, an installer, the subsidy paperwork and a tariff by hand. Czech homeowners face the same assembly with NZÚ money attached, so the model transfers. URGENCY 0: the source names no dated instrument. SCALE 2 (households heating with fossil fuel, a sector). RECURRENCE 2 (the operating half is continuous). MATURITY (abroad): ESTABLISHED on the source's own figures — founded late 2022 (just over 3 years) and a public customer count (more than 2,500 systems installed), with EUR 20.1M 2025 revenue. CZ CHECK, Czech-language queries run 2026-09-28: (1) 'tepelné čerpadlo na klíč včetně vyřízení dotace a baterie řízení podle spotové ceny elektřiny'; (2) 'tepelné čerpadlo pro bytový dům SVJ na klíč dodavatel optimalizace dynamický tarif'; (3) 'tepelné čerpadlo online nabídka montáž a vyřízení dotace Nová zelená úsporám celá ČR firma'. FOUND: Woltair s.r.o. (IČO 06770525, ARES datumVzniku 2018-01-16) sells heat pumps and PV installed end-to-end including the subsidy paperwork, in CZ and abroad — already in our own ledger as round-woltair (EUR 20.5M Series A extension, 2023-06-07) and named on p-0002 — competes: direct, maturity: established (over 3 years; Series A). E.ON Energie, a.s. (IČO 26078201, since 2004) sells heat pumps installed with a discount and subsidy guidance (eon.cz/zivnostnici/sluzby/tepelne-cerpadlo/, saved) — competes: direct, maturity: early ON THE TEST (a 2004 national supplier, but this pass receipted only one public buyer line, smlouvy-36838746, and no customer count or licence on the page read; the test is mechanical and is recorded as it returns). AC Heating s.r.o. (IČO 29156203, since 2012) — a Czech heat-pump manufacturer with its own NZÚ subsidy service (the search result ac-heating.cz/nova-zelena-usporam/ returned 404 on re-fetch, saved) — competes: adjacent (manufacturer, not an operator of the household's energy system), maturity: early on the test (since 2012, no second limb receipted). Nano Energies (Nano Energies CZ s.r.o., IČO 28188861) sells dynamic/spot electricity tariffs and flexibility — competes: adjacent (the tariff half, not the heating system), maturity: early on the test (no second limb receipted on this pass). Not found: a Czech seller of the OPERATING half as a product, i.e. an energy-management layer that runs a household heat pump + battery against the spot price as a service; query (1) surfaced only generic FVE-control vendors (SmartSpot for businesses) and installers' marketing copy. That is a sub-niche observation, not a verdict. VERDICT: taken — the install-plus-subsidy package is sold by an established Czech player (Woltair), with E.ON selling the same. POSITIVE CONTROL: (a) ARES name search 'Wultra' (standing register control, run 2026-09-28) -> Wultra s.r.o., IČO 03643174, datumVzniku 2014-12-15; (b) query (3) surfaced AC Heating s.r.o. (IČO 29156203), a known Czech heat-pump maker — the Czech descriptive method surfaces real Czech vendors in this space. PASSED. COMPARABLE FOR: p-0002 (installer back office — GALVANY is the vertically-integrated alternative to selling software to installers) and p-0025 (retrofit execution patchwork).

title: mika — AI bookkeeping, VAT returns and annual accounts for small companies, checked by trained accountants
money_note: EUR 6M seed announced 2026-09-24 (Vestbee, the url), led by Smedvig Ventures; stated in EUR, no FX needed.
summary: Berlin-based mika runs an AI-native general ledger built for German accounting that processes receipts and payments, categorises and books transactions, and prepares VAT returns, annual accounts and tax filings for small limited companies, with trained accountants reviewing the output. It raised a EUR 6M seed round in September 2026 and reports more than 750 GmbH and UG customers.
notes: TRANSFER LOGIC: a small s.r.o. owes the same annual cycle in Czechia — bookkeeping, DPH and kontrolní hlášení, závěrka, přiznání — and today buys it either as software it runs itself or as an accountant's hours. mika sells the done-for-you outcome at software cost. URGENCY 0 (none in the source). SCALE 3 (every small company, cross-sector). RECURRENCE 3 would overstate a commercial model; scored 2 (monthly and annual, continuous). MATURITY (abroad): EARLY — founded 2024, so the >=3-years limb fails; traction limb met (750+ paying companies, EUR 1M+ ARR). CZ CHECK, Czech-language queries run 2026-09-28: (1) 'online účetnictví pro s.r.o. s účetní, doklady zaúčtuje umělá inteligence, přiznání k DPH a závěrka'; (2) 'účetní kancelář online AI automatické zaúčtování bankovních pohybů a faktur pro malé firmy měsíční paušál'. HCH Consulting s.r.o. (IČO 06130381, ARES since 2017-05-25; its page says accounting and tax services since 1999) sells an 'Online účetnictví' app with AI bank matching plus access to its accountants — competes: direct, maturity: early ON THE TEST (over 3 years, but no customer count, public buyer, funding or certification receipted on the page read — an old firm the test cannot pass, recorded as the test says). MyÚčto.cz (online ERP/accounting with AI document extraction, 'tisíce firem') — competes: adjacent (software sold to firms and accounting offices, no done-for-you service). Digitoo, ÚčtoKrab, ÚčtoRobot, DokladBot, Vytěžovák — AI document extraction into Pohoda/ABRA — competes: adjacent (a tool for the accountant, not the outcome). VERDICT: taken — iÚčto sells software plus accountant service to 40,000+ Czech businesses. POSITIVE CONTROL: (a) ARES name search 'Wultra' (standing register control, run 2026-09-28) -> Wultra s.r.o., IČO 03643174, datumVzniku 2014-12-15; (b) query (2) surfaced iÚčto and MyÚčto, known Czech online-accounting vendors, and query (1) surfaced Ježek software (Duel), a known Czech accounting-software house — the Czech descriptive method surfaces real vendors here. title: Duqu — cash advances against unpaid B2B invoices, paid within 24 hours without selling the invoice
money_note: EUR 1.5M pre-seed announced 2026-09-24 (tech.eu, the url; Vestbee reports the same round the same day), from Curiosity VC and No Such Ventures; stated in EUR, no FX needed.
summary: Amsterdam-based Duqu advances the amount of an outstanding B2B invoice to the business that issued it, usually within 24 hours, while the business keeps ownership of the invoice and its customer relationship. It raised EUR 1.5M pre-seed in September 2026 and also licenses its AI underwriting engine to banks and lenders as a white-label product.
notes: TRANSFER LOGIC: late B2B payment starves small suppliers of working capital everywhere; the product is fast, per-invoice liquidity without a factoring contract. URGENCY 0. SCALE 3 (every invoicing SME). RECURRENCE 2. MATURITY (abroad): EARLY — founded 2025, pre-seed, no customer count published. CZ CHECK, Czech-language queries run 2026-09-28: (1) 'financování vystavených faktur online peníze do 24 hodin pro malé firmy bez faktoringu'; (2) 'předfinancování neuhrazené faktury odběratel neplatí včas firma dostane peníze hned poplatek'. (IČO 06790887, ARES since 2018-01-23) — finances issued and received invoices from 3,000 CZK, money the same or next day, without informing the customer; 'Cashbot poskytl firmám a OSVČ už více než 25 000 financování v hodnotě přes 1 750 000 000 Kč' (cashbot.cz, saved) — competes: direct, maturity: established. Platební instituce Roger a.s. (IČO 01729462, ARES since 2013-06-05; a ČNB-licensed payment institution) — pays up to 90% of an invoice within 24 hours, invoices from 25,000 CZK (roger.cz/factoring-platba/, saved) — competes: direct, maturity: established. Bibby Financial Services and SMart Credit sell recourse factoring — competes: adjacent (a factoring contract, which Duqu's model avoids). VERDICT: taken — Cashbot and Roger both sell fast single-invoice financing to Czech SMEs at scale. POSITIVE CONTROL: (a) ARES name search 'Wultra' (standing register control, run 2026-09-28) -> Wultra s.r.o., IČO 03643174, datumVzniku 2014-12-15; (b) query (1) surfaced Bibby Financial Services, a known factoring house operating in Czechia — the Czech descriptive method surfaces real vendors here. PASSED. COMPARABLE FOR: no existing record in data/problems/cz/ covers SME working capital; comparison point only.

title: Tandem Health — ambient AI scribe that drafts the clinical note from the consultation
money_note: USD 100M Series B, 2026-09-14, led by the Scaleup Europe Fund managed by EQT with Kinnevik, Northzone, Amino Collective and Visionaries (the company's release, the url). USD 100M converted at ~0.86 EUR/USD. Total raised USD 160M including a USD 50M Series A in 2025.
summary: Stockholm-based Tandem Health sells clinicians an AI scribe that listens to the consultation and drafts the structured note, plus a coding assistant and clinical decision support, each certified Class IIa under EU MDR. It says 10,000 care organisations across 14 European markets use it.
notes: TRANSFER LOGIC: a Czech doctor types the finding or the report after (or during) every visit; an ambient scribe listens to the consultation and drafts the structured note for the clinician to approve, and a coding assistant proposes the codes from it. Tandem sells both across 14 European countries, none of them Czechia (the release lists Germany, France, UK, Spain, Italy, Netherlands, Sweden, Finland, Norway, Denmark, Belgium, Portugal, Estonia, Lithuania). RECEIPTS: amount AND date from the company's own release (the url, saved as pages/tandemhealth_ai_resources_news_tandem-health-raises-100m-...html): byline 'By Tandem Health · 14 Sept 2026 · Fundraising' and the quote. Corroborated by TNW, 2026-09-15 ('The company announced the round on 14 September', saved as pages/thenextweb_com_news_tandem-health-100m-series-b-scaleup-europe-fund.html) and ArcticStartup, 2026-09-22 (saved). URGENCY 0 (no dated instrument). SCALE 2 (every clinician in a sector). RECURRENCE 2 (every visit, continuous). MATURITY (abroad): EARLY by the letter of SCORING.md — founded 2023, so under the 3 years of selling the established test requires, despite Series B, 10,000 care organisations and named customers (Ramsay Santé, Humanitas, NHS per TNW). Stated so the record layer does not over-read it. CZ CHECK, Czech-language queries run 2026-09-28: (1) 'automatický přepis lékařské zprávy z rozhovoru s pacientem AI'; (2) 'AI asistent lékař dokumentace ambulance nahrává rozhovor s pacientem a píše zprávu'; (3) 'hlasové zadávání lékařská zpráva ambulantní software diktování'. All three shapes return Czech ambient scribes. FOUND, competes: direct (all early): Medivox s.r.o. (IČO 24901946, ARES datumVzniku 2026-04-01; founders say they started early 2025 — nasezdravotnictvi.cz interview, saved; prices published, 2,075 Kč/month Pro); AurisOne s.r.o. (IČO 22151265, ARES 2024-10-14; '1,5 roku v ostrém provozu', 20,000+ reports, named customer MEDICA Třinec; 1st place Czech DIGI@MED Award 2025, Zdravotnický deník 2026-05-27, saved); Mirek AI by Bindworks s.r.o. (IČO 07436505, ARES 2018-09-06 — the firm is older than the product; 2nd place DIGI@MED 2025; product launch date not receipted, so early); mAIdoc (HealthProGroup, operator IČO not resolved); Emmy Scribe (the 'virtuální sestra Emmy' GP-practice product line; scribe launch date not receipted, so early). digitalhealth.cz's own AI-scribe test names exactly these five as the competing tools on the Czech market (saved). Medicalc software s.r.o. (IČO 26350513) — already on p-0036 as direct/early — turns a phone recording of a ward round into a structured report: direct, early, AGREES with p-0036. ADJACENT, established: NEWTON Technologies a.s. (IČO 28479777, ARES 2008-10-27, NEWTON Dictate) — dictation into the hospital system, no conversation capture or note drafting; AGREES with p-0036 (adjacent/established). ICZ (IČO 25145444, Asistent vykazování AV(D)) — on p-0036 it is direct/established, because p-0036's product is coding and structuring an existing report; here it is ADJACENT because it codes a report someone already wrote and does not write the note. DIVERGENCE STATED, NOT HIDDEN: Tandem also sells an AI coding assistant, and on that leg ICZ is an established Czech seller — which is exactly why p-0036 carries gap 0. This verdict is about the scribe leg only. STAPRO (IČO 13583531, AI asistent výkaznictví pilot) — adjacent for the same reason. VERDICT: contested — five-plus Czech ambient scribes sell this, every one under three years old, and the Medivox founders say 'Konkurence rychle přibývá'. NOTE FOR p-0036: its locals[] names none of Medivox, AurisOne, Mirek AI, mAIdoc or Emmy Scribe; they belong there as direct/early on the note-writing step if the record's solution reaches it. POSITIVE CONTROL: (a) ARES name search 'Wultra' (standing register control, run 2026-09-28) -> Wultra s.r.o., IČO 03643174, datumVzniku 2014-12-15; (b) dictation-shaped Czech queries (3) and (4) 'diktování lékařských zpráv přímo do nemocničního informačního systému převod řeči na text' surfaced NovaVoice (Consulting Company Novasoft, FN Motol) and NEWTON Dictate (NEWTON Technologies, in the market since 2008), both known Czech medical speech vendors, NEWTON already on p-0036 — the Czech descriptive method surfaces real Czech vendors here. PASSED. COMPARABLE FOR: p-0036 (hospital clinical documentation).

players.name: Medivox s.r.o.
players.evidence: Records the doctor-patient conversation and drafts a structured medical report (anamnesis, examination, diagnosis, plan) for GPs and specialists, with published prices. ARES since 2026-04-01; founders date the start to early 2025 — under 3 years.

players.name: AurisOne s.r.o. (Auris One)
players.evidence: Listens to the consultation and assembles a structured record, admission report and nursing notes; claims 1.5 years in live operation, 20,000+ reports and names MEDICA Třinec. ARES since 2024-10-14 — under 3 years.

players.name: Mirek AI (Bindworks s.r.o.)
players.evidence: Ambient assistant that transcribes the consultation with speaker separation and writes the report; HL7/FHIR integration offered for hospital systems. Bindworks dates from 2018 but the product's launch is not receipted; the test counts years selling this product, so early.

players.name: mAIdoc
players.evidence: Transcribes and summarises the doctor-patient conversation into documentation with templates for GP, specialist, psychologist and dentist; free tier published. Operator (HealthProGroup) IČO not resolved and no customer receipted on this pass.

players.name: Emmy Scribe (virtuální sestra Emmy)
players.evidence: Records the consultation and produces a transcript and summary to paste into the practice system; quotes named GPs. The Emmy practice product is older, but the scribe's launch date is not receipted, so early.

players.name: Medicalc software s.r.o.
players.evidence: Hospital information system vendor (ARES 2002-11-07) whose director described in January 2026 AI that turns a phone recording of a ward round or consultation into a structured report; no hospital receipted as running it. Same entry as p-0036 locals[].

players.name: NEWTON Technologies a.s. (NEWTON Dictate)
players.evidence: Sells Czech medical dictation into the hospital system since 2008 — speech to free text, no conversation capture and no drafted note. Same entry as p-0036 locals[].

players.name: ICZ (Asistent vykazování AV(D))
players.evidence: Sells machine-learning coding of an already-written discharge report to named hospitals (FN Brno, Kolín, Znojmo). Direct on p-0036's coding product; adjacent here because it does not write the clinical note. It does compete with Tandem's coding-assistant leg.
